skills.name: browse-collection
skills.description: Browse every object in The Meridian archive, arranged by field, by era or A–Z, and narrowed to The Island thread or to objects whose research is ongoing. Each object page gives its maker, materials, origin, era, verification status, provenance, a researched story with references, and a citation.

skills.name: explore-timeline
skills.description: The sky over time: a dial across the centuries in which every object rises as a star in the year it was made, narratives form as constellations, and era shelves hold every object.

skills.name: read-narratives
skills.description: Stories told across objects: each narrative joins objects acquired separately into a single account (a year, a maker, a war, a way of seeing), drawn as a constellation.

skills.name: the-island-thread
skills.description: Sri Lanka and Ceylon across every century: the Island thread's maps, photographs, documents and books in year order, and what the thread is still seeking.

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search objects, narratives, fields and the archive pages. Pass words as ?q=, for example /search/?q=Ceylon. The index behind it is at /search-index.json.

skills.name: read-about
skills.description: Learn about The Meridian archive, its collecting policy, verification standard and want list, and the collector behind it.
